correctness.rationale: The quadratic form H(u,v)=1/2 sqrt(3u^2+2uv+3v^2) is Hilbertian. On uv>=0 the two exact differences establish H<=N<=sqrt(3/2)H; on uv<=0, after |u|=a>=b=|v|, the differences factor as (a-b)(a+3b)/4 and (a-3b)^2/8, proving the same sharp sandwich. Hilbert Ptolemy therefore yields C_Pt<=3/2. The triple (-1,-1),(2,-2),(1,-3) has numerator 9 and denominator 6, so equality holds. Every step is exact algebra.
